candidate.title: The Controlled Transfer
candidate.spokenScript:
Three clubs. Two hands. One safety inspector.

He watched me for six minutes, then pointed at the red club.

"What happens if you drop that?"
"It lands on the floor."
"And if you catch it?"
"It doesn't."

He wrote that down. Twice.

Then he confiscated the red club. Preventive measures.

Now I do two clubs. One at a time, below shoulder height. Last night a child offered me a third club from the gift shop. Security removed him.

I asked for the red one back.

"Prove you can safely juggle three."
"You watched me do it."
"That was before we made it safe. It doesn't count."

He's returning it Friday, in person.

I'm not allowed to take it while juggling. He's not allowed to throw it.

So we'll stand there, holding one end each.

He's selling tickets to the handover.

I'm still not allowed to perform.
candidate.voiceMusicStyle: Suno Speech beta. Spoken English stand-up, not a song. A dry, quick-thinking adult clown, light mid-range voice with crisp consonants; impatient when interrupted, matter-of-fact about absurd rules. Close-miked foreground speech, brisk conversational pace, short pointed pauses only after the inspector's contradictions. Low-volume live rockabilly backing: upright bass, rim-click snare, hollow-body electric guitar. Music drops to near-silence for the final handover. No singing, chorus, ad-libs, audience laughter or vocal doubling. Stop cleanly after the last sentence.
candidate.producerCuesNotSpoken: 0-4s: cold open, three physical clubs. 5-17s: inspector exchange, no band stings. 18-32s: consequences and child removed, dry acceleration. 33-46s: inspector's impossible proof request, half-beat silence. 47-59s: handover callback, band drops out; clean ending. All timings editorial guesses, not audio-aligned.
